text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Out of the way, out of the waaaay! Take 
thiiiiiis!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nwaaaagh... aaaaaaah! Like I'd... ever 
stay down!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(These two... just how far can they 
go...?!)

text_block_list.name: Inari & Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
Ora ora ora oraaaaaaahhh!! Huff, wheeze... 
hyaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh... OOOOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Inari One!! Leave 'em all in 
the dust just like that!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Go, Yaeno Muteki! Hang on until the very 
end!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, Bamboo! You can still do 
this!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One surges forward with ferocious 
intensity, looking like a totally changed 
woman. Bamboo Memory desperately pushes 
forward, pushing herself to the absolute 
limit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was a run that looked as if pure 
fighting spirit was driving her body 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...*pant*... *gasp*... *wheeze*... I... 
gave it everything I had...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heheh, look who's showing some real guts!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Because... I really wanted to win!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Yaeno! What are you spacing out for?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, you were holding back on me! 
You've got way more in the tank than that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aha, struck a nerve, did I? Then leaving 
it like this would leave a bad taste in 
both our mouths, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Next! I'm running in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)! If you're looking for a do-over, 
you'd better show up too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm running too! After all, Oguri-senpai 
is scheduled to run in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...The Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: If you're gonna race, show me some guts!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"You're holding back your true 
strength..." That's what Inari-san told 
me...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I ran, burning my "obsession" to the 
absolute limit...! I gave it every last 
ounce of my strength...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, Bamboo-san also mentioned before 
that I wasn't giving it my all...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that without even realizing 
it... I truly haven't been giving it my 
all...?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...What are your thoughts, Trainer-dono?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Was my running different from Inari-san's 
or Bamboo-san's...?
choice_data_list:
The two of them exhausted all their 
strength from their fierce fighting 
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt that a fighting spirit was driving 
my body. I told them that bringing out a 
fierce competitive drive for victory had 
unleashed a hidden strength that pushed 
beyond all limits.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: From a fierce fighting spirit...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Giving it everything they have to break 
past their limits. That's how Inari-san 
and the others fight...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list:
I don't think Yaeno has been able to use 
her full strength yet.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list:
Because your racing is all about not 
unleashing everything at once

Because your racing is all about holding 
something back

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For keeping her fighting spirit contained 
rather than unleashed, controlling it to 
prevent recklessness, is 'Union of Fire 
and Water'—that is Yaeno Muteki's running 
style.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that if she channels all her 
raw emotion and gives it everything, there 
might just be a chance she can run beyond 
her current limits.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, it remains to be seen whether 
Yaeno Muteki herself can keep that fiery 
passion under control.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before even that, I explained that we 
didn't even know if she could unleash the 
suppressed passion inside her or bring it 
to the surface."
choice_data_list:
Because you're afraid of acting on pure 
passion.

Because you're afraid to act on your 
passions,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's why even if she tries to unleash 
her fighting spirit, she might 
unconsciously end up suppressing that 
passion."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result, there's even the risk that 
her running form could completely fall 
apart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that casting aside "Unity of 
Fire and Water" to run with her fighting 
spirit completely unleashed carried 
immense risk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, I add that if Yaeno Muteki still 
wishes to pursue the method of unleashing 
her passions, I am fully prepared to do 
everything in my power to support her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I deeply apologize. I would like to 
request a moment of your time.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I'll keep looking into other options 
in the meantime.

Yeah. I'll continue looking for other 
methods, too.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I will deliberate on 
it. Thoroughly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the racecourse behind, I walk 
along the road to the station with Yaeno 
Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki seemed to have shifted her 
mindset, walking forward with her head 
held high and eyes fixed straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer-dono, I would like to set our 
next goal on the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is held at Tokyo 
Racecourse, which in my opinion is a track 
that suits Yaeno Muteki. The distance 
won't be an issue either.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I heard Oguri-san is also running in the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Oguri-san's popularity is soaring right 
now. I wonder just how strong she has 
become...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is able to draw strength from 
her fans' cheers and make it her own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Oguri craze sweeping up young and 
old, men and women alike, it's safe to say 
her true strength is immeasurable.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Nevertheless, in my humble opinion, 
focusing on what must be done right now is 
best."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you hit a wall, do not stop in 
your tracks to brood. Keep running while 
you work through your doubts."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Starting tomorrow, let's give it 
our all again for the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
